about: Bridge City Law works from Portland, Gresham and Beaverton, publishes in Spanish and runs a 24 hour line. 284 reviews at 4.91 across three listings.
It states no fee model and no free consultation in terms we could record, publishes only a privacy policy of the trust pages pillar D looks for, and names no attorney on the pages we could reach.
